concerns.text: Task T023 and T024 both target `src/resampling/engine.py`, creating overlapping responsibilities (subset generation vs. OLS fitting & convergence). This ambiguity can hinder deterministic implementation; split into separate modules or clarify ownership.

Task T024 bundles many distinct deliverables (per‑subset metrics, OLS fitting loop, bootstrap convergence, multiple artifact files) into a single task, making it overly coarse. Recommend atomizing into smaller, verifiable tasks (e.g., T024a: compute per‑subset metrics, T024b: bootstrap convergence check, etc.).

Task T007 defines a checkpoint schema and save/load functions but does not specify a concrete verification step (e.g., a unit test that a saved checkpoint validates against the schema). Add a test or explicit acceptance criterion to ensure schema compliance.

Task T031 requires a multiple regression with an interaction term, yet the verification only mentions the output JSON. Include a verification step (e.g., a test that the fitted model contains the `C(severity):cond_num` interaction term) to guarantee the model meets the specification.
